statement: Every code-only merge into main of the last recorded ones is live within 1 s from its landing (the push of the merge commit to main, GitHub's activity API; merged_at comes 1-2 s later) to its code running (the queue swap's pointer seen by the heir, or an ordered reload done); D-337: the whole sample, its maximum, the median only reports. The deploy builds' seconds stay in runs/deploy.json as the slow path's cost.
